title: index-hero — the page's own contents as the opening composition
idea: The hero is the page's own table of contents: the site name, then its real sections as a numbered index the visitor can jump into. It promises the whole page instead of pitching one line.
why_new: no hero carries navigation as content, and none is built from the page plan itself.
built_from: heading plus a list of real section anchors — no image, and no copy that can be invented.
risk: needs the section list before the hero is authored, and duplicates the header nav on thin pages; gate to four or more real sections.
